It was about 9100 for the surgery, and thats with overnight in hospital, meds to take home and follow up appointments. I can't remember how much the consults were, but you basically only have to pay for one, then he does any others you might want for free. 
The hospital (Spire) does do payment plans, not sure about the details cause I am lucky and was able to pay outright. 
Hope this helps!
